title: Advanced Information Operations Planner (I) (LtCol to 1stLt) FMOS, DC I
raw_text:
10. MOS 0550, Advanced Information Operations Planner (I) (LtCol to 1stLt)
FMOS, DC I

    a. Summary. Advanced Information Operations Planners plan, coordinate,
execute and assess information. These officers advise commanding generals,
their staff sections and MAGTF commanders on the conduct of information as
well as the development of policy and doctrine for full spectrum information
activities. This is done as part of a larger information forces staff, from
the MEF major subordinate command level up to joint/theater level staffs.
This MOS will be assigned to officers as a non-PMOS only by the CMC (MM).

       b.   Prerequisites

            (1) Security requirement:     active secret security clearance.

        (2) Must be currently in or have orders to fill, an Information
Planner billet.

       c.   Requirements

        (1) Complete the Staff Operations in the Information Environment
Planner Course (SOPC) (M02HE5D), Quantico, VA.

        (2) Rank of Capt and below must also complete the MAGTF Operations in
the Information Environment Practitioner Course (MOPC) (M02F2GD), Quantico,
VA.

        (3) Any of these requirements may be waived by the Deputy Commandant
for Information based on unique work or educational experience.

    d. Duties. For a complete listing of duties and tasks, refer to
reference (aq), MAGTF Planner’s Training and Readiness (T/R) Manual.



                                            1-37                         Enclosure (1)
 1108                                                                 NAVMC 1200.1L



    e. Related Standard Occupational Classification (SOC) Title and Code.
No civilian equivalent.

       f.   Related Military Skill

            (1) Influence Officer , 1707.

            (2) Basic Information Planner, 1781.

            (3) Technical Information Staff Officer, 8834.

nlx_method: NLx employer-demand profiles; private-only ownership unverified. Six-digit profiles pool specialty weighted task incidences after the existing review exclusion mask and five-job task-support floor; destination SOCs require 200 postings and nonzero tasks. Military profiles use binary accepted task presence and the same NLx reference RCA weights as civilian profiles: reciprocal positive task shares (zero weight for reference-absent tasks) of pooled retained support-five NLx weighted incidences across 1,016 reference specialties (912 eligible comparison candidates), sqrt(q * rca_weight), then L2 normalization and cosine. No military crosswalk codes enter the task ranking. All positive top-20 results retained; zero-similarity destinations are not recommendations. Shared field/rating duties are included; general Naval Standards remain separate by paygrade. Summary compares non-future individual source entries (versions can repeat) with nonempty reference sets; grouped, future and general-standard entries remain in all outputs. Hit@k is the fraction with at least one reference SOC recovered; ties are averaged exactly. References outside NLx remain in denominators. DMDC reference status is from July 2024, not current 2026 status.
